scripts.init: npm install && dotnet restore && dotnet tool restore
scripts.validate:agents: dotnet fsi --warnaserror --warnon:3886 scripts/ValidateAgentDefinitions.fsx --self-test && dotnet fsi --warnaserror --warnon:3886 scripts/ValidateAgentDefinitions.fsx
scripts.fable: npm run fantomas && dotnet fable --lang typescript --outDir ../generated --cwd ./src/Wilnaatahl.Core && dotnet fsi --warnaserror --warnon:3886 scripts/PatchFableModules.fsx
scripts.build: npm run validate:agents && npm run fable && npm run prettier && tsc && vite build
scripts.dev: npm run fable && npm run prettier && vite
scripts.preview: npm run fable && npm run prettier && vite preview
scripts.test:koota: npm run test:koota:prepare && vitest run kootaConformance
scripts.coverage: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('TestResults',{recursive:true,force:true})" && dotnet test --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage" --results-directory TestResults
scripts.coverage:ts: npm run test:koota:prepare && vitest run --coverage && dotnet reportgenerator -reports:coveragereport-ts/cobertura-coverage.xml -targetdir:coveragereport-ts -reporttypes:JsonSummary
scripts.coverage:check: npm run coverage && dotnet reportgenerator -reports:TestResults/**/coverage.cobertura.xml -targetdir:coveragereport -reporttypes:JsonSummary && npm run coverage:ts && dotnet fsi --warnaserror --warnon:3886 scripts/CheckCoverage.fsx --self-test && dotnet fsi --warnaserror --warnon:3886 scripts/CheckCoverage.fsx
scripts.format: npm run prettier && npm run fantomas
